scheme_name: Chief Minister Agriculture and Food Processing Scheme
other_conditions: Beneficiary must possess an Aadhaar Card or PAN Card.
Beneficiary must have a good Bank CIBIL score.
Beneficiary must provide a 7/12 certificate and either an 8‑A certificate or lease documents.
benefits_summary: Provides up to a 30% subsidy (capped at Rs 50 lakhs) for construction of agriculture and food processing units, payable in two instalments after project completion and full commercial production.
documents_required: Recommendation of District level Project Implementation Committee
